card.title: A pendulum that shows Earth turning

body.claim: The Foucault pendulum is a simple device conceived as an experiment to demonstrate the Earth's rotation.
body.why: If a long and heavy pendulum is monitored over an extended period of time, its plane of oscillation appears to change spontaneously as the Earth makes its 24-hourly rotation. This effect is greatest at the poles and diminishes with lower latitude until it no longer exists at Earth's equator.

probes.question: In which year did Foucault introduce his pendulum?
True or false: the Foucault pendulum effect no longer exists at Earth's equator.

image_brief.show: A Foucault pendulum hanging in a museum or the Panthéon
